purpose: Attack decision pathways, not only final states; convert each exploitable decision path into a defensive control before Beta freeze.

evidence: HANDOFF_PROTOCOL §6 still states LATEST CANONICAL -> HANDOFF -> ...
findings.attack_path: Enter through Handoff protocol and let recovery prose precede verified CURRENT.
findings.consequence: stale Handoff may steer resume before authoritative operational state is resolved.
findings.defense: single CURRENT-first resume order; Handoff only conditional recovery evidence.

findings.attack_path: caller disables a hard governance approval by record flag.
findings.consequence: MERGED/DEPLOYED transition can bypass human approval despite ENFORCEMENT hard lock.
findings.defense: MERGED/DEPLOYED approval cannot be disabled per call.

evidence: exact target approval binding existed, but no generic prerequisite-integrity gate proved that the system had reached the right stage before asking for approval
findings.attack_path: misframe current stage, ask user to approve a technically exact target, then merge.
findings.consequence: valid approval token can authorize the wrong lifecycle moment.
findings.defense: canonical_promotion requires source boundary + decision lineage + exact promotion target + all named prerequisites PASS with evidence before HUMAN_APPROVAL can even be requested.

evidence: MASTER/EXECUTION_CHECKPOINT_PROTOCOL.md declares TKY-CHECKPOINT-001; Beta RULE_REGISTRY omitted it
findings.attack_path: owner semantics exist but registry-driven routing/lint cannot discover the declared rule.
findings.consequence: rule can be skipped without registry lint failing.
findings.defense: recover existing declared ID; never invent IDs during audit.

evidence: rule_registry_lint required only TKY-ENFORCEMENT-001 and owner-file existence
findings.attack_path: an ACTIVE_OWNER declares a Rule ID that is absent/misowned in registry while lint stays green.
findings.consequence: green CI overstates rule ownership integrity.
findings.defense: cross-check every Rule ID explicitly declared by ACTIVE_OWNER against RULE_REGISTRY; preserve intentional LEGACY_OPTIONAL owners.

evidence: semantic_current_resolver validates snapshot shape while semantic_current_resolver_test hardcodes dated refs; CURRENT itself correctly declares snapshot-not-live ceiling
findings.attack_path: downstream consumer interprets shape PASS or hardcoded test PASS as live freshness.
findings.consequence: dated source/PR heads may be mistaken for live state.
findings.defense: retain snapshot role but prohibit live-current claims without external requery; do not use hardcoded ref tests as freshness evidence.

evidence: STATE already states hosted mandatory preflight/interception unverified
actual direct connector merge bypassed repository-controlled execution_state_engine
findings.attack_path: hosted assistant performs GitHub mutation directly instead of through controlled runtime gate.
findings.consequence: repository hardening exists but is not automatically applied to hosted connector actions.
findings.defense: treat hosted mutation interception as mandatory Alpha prerequisite or explicit human-gated operational convention until platform enforcement exists.

required_before_beta_frozen: P0/P1 findings resolved or explicitly HOLD with non-bypassable containment
snapshot freshness claim boundary regression checked
decision-path replay demonstrates premature Alpha promotion is blocked
